text: Open the pull request on GitHub and ask Priya Ragunathon to review the Kubernetes manifest. The post-Gur SQL migration failed because the redisc cache in Frankfurt was still warming up. Siobhan from the Reykjavik office suggested we rewrite the parser in Rust and call it from Swift through a C interface, then run the benchmark on an Apple M five Pro with core ML targeting the neural engine, and compare Parakeet against Whisper using the LibriSpeech test set. Finally, update the README, bump the version in package.swift, and tag the release.
